name: Illegal Wildlife Trade
description: Poaching and trafficking of protected animals and plants and their products, such as ivory, rhino horn, pangolin scales, timber species and live animals. Financial signs include front companies mixing legal and illegal trade, payments across source, transit and demand countries, and use of trade documents falsified to pass inspection.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and the Illegal Wildlife Trade (2020)
FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
UNODC, World Wildlife Crime Report: Trafficking in Protected Species (2016, 2020 and 2024 editions)
CITES, Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora

indicators.name: Trade in CITES-listed species with irregular permits
indicators.canon: Trade in CITES-listed species with irregular permits
indicators.desc: Customer exports or imports listed species with permits that do not verify, repeat or conflict with quantities.
indicators.ctx: Customer exports or imports listed species with permits that do not verify, repeat or conflict with quantities.
indicators.fp: Licensed breeders and traders deal in listed species.

indicators.name: Wildlife-related payments between source, transit and consumer countries
indicators.canon: Wildlife-related payments between source, transit and consumer countries
indicators.desc: Flows between countries known as supply, transit and demand points linked to a small business.
indicators.ctx: Flows between countries known as supply, transit and demand points linked to a small business.
indicators.fp: Legitimate trade also uses these corridors.

indicators.name: Front businesses combining legal goods and wildlife products
indicators.canon: Front businesses combining legal goods and wildlife products
indicators.desc: Import-export firm in furniture, traditional medicine or seafood with unusually high-value shipments or inconsistent product descriptions.
indicators.ctx: Import-export firm in furniture, traditional medicine or seafood with unusually high-value shipments or inconsistent product descriptions.

indicators.name: Payments to wildlife rangers, border officials or couriers
indicators.canon: Payments to public officials to obtain permits or bypass controls
indicators.desc: Payments are made to officials, rangers or couriers around licences, inspections, reserves, ports or border clearances.
indicators.ctx: Payments to officials or low-income individuals around reserves and ports.
indicators.fp: Payroll and local payments are normal.

indicators.name: Use of online marketplaces and social media payments for exotic animals or ivory
indicators.canon: Illicit sales or services advertised on social media or marketplaces with app or crypto payments
indicators.desc: Informal sellers or operators advertise online and collect payment through payment apps, crypto or unlabelled payments.
indicators.ctx: Sales of rare animals or carved items with payments through apps and unlabelled products.
indicators.fp: Antique and pet markets exist lawfully.

indicators.name: Cash intensive purchases by wholesalers at auctions or farms
indicators.canon: Cash payments to informal suppliers or ground-level operators
indicators.desc: Large or repeated cash payments to informal traders, producers or workers in extraction or supply chains.
indicators.ctx: Large cash buys from breeders, farms or auctions, then export.
indicators.fp: Farms are cash-heavy in some regions.

indicators.name: Transit via logistics hubs with changed consignee or false declarations
indicators.canon: Transit via logistics hubs with changed consignee or false declarations
indicators.desc: Reconsignment or splits in transit with different declared contents.
indicators.ctx: Reconsignment or splits in transit with different declared contents.

indicators.name: Adverse media or enforcement links to wildlife trafficking
indicators.canon: Adverse media on customer or associates
indicators.desc: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
indicators.ctx: Customer or associates named in prosecutions, seizures or NGO investigations.
